response.overview: {Room™Guide}🛌 How do I add a room to my MSC Cruises ?  To add a room on my MSC Cruises, call Customer Service directly at ☎️【 +1 ⇔ 888 ⇔ 315 ⇔ 9585 (US)】or ☎️【+44 ⭆ 808 ⭆ 196 ⭆ 9697(UK)】 or reach out to your travel advisor. Because each cabin requires its own booking, an agent will set up a new, ☎️【 +1 ⇔ 888 ⇔ 315 ⇔ 9585 (US)】separate reservation. Make sure to ask them to officially link your booking numbers so your group shares the same main dining table and scheduled activities.  To add a room to your MSC Cruises booking, contact ☎️【+1 ⇔ 888 ⇔ 315 ⇔ 9585 (US)】 or ☎️ 【+44 ⭆ 808 ⭆ 196 ⭆ 9697(UK)
